title: Helix bench result.v2
description: Versioned per-task result contract written by every downstream bench phase (76-89) and validated against this schema. BENCH-03 / FAIR-03 (substrate only).
$comment: Versioning policy (D-03/D-04): schema_version is a single flat greppable top-level string pinned to "v2". Additive-only changes are MINOR: new fields land OPTIONAL and additionalProperties is left OPEN at the top level so adding a field never requires a schema bump. A BREAKING change (removing/renaming a field, tightening a constraint, or making a new field required) bumps the major version to v3 (a new result.v3.schema.json). FAIR-03 SCOPE: this schema carries only the FAIR-03 SUBSTRATE — the cached-input token columns (tokens_input_cached_read, tokens_input_cache_write, D-12) and the fairness.overrides[] array (D-10). The >5% between-run variance DETECTOR and the cost_quality.md fairness WARNING are NOT part of this schema; they land in Phase 82 (variance gate, consumes STATS-01 N>=3) and Phase 89 (reports).

schema_version.description: Result-contract version. Flat, greppable, pinned to the string "v2" (D-04). The ONLY required field (D-03/Pitfall 5) so every other field can be added optionally without a major bump.

task_id.description: Stable identifier of the benchmark task this result describes (e.g. "swe-bench-lite/django__django-12345").

mode.description: Helix profile mode exercised for this run (e.g. read, edit, review, admin).

benchmark.description: Name of the benchmark suite this task belongs to (e.g. "swe-bench-lite").

run_index.description: Zero- or one-based repetition index for this task within a multi-run sample (STATS-01 N>=3 consumes this downstream in Phase 82).

tokens_input.description: Total input (prompt) tokens billed for this run. Relaxed to nullable (Phase 79, Open Q5): the canonical home for metrics is now the `metrics` object — this top-level column is retained nullable for additive-only backward compatibility with metric-sparse fixtures.

tokens_output.description: Total output (completion) tokens billed for this run. Relaxed to nullable (Phase 79, Open Q5) — see tokens_input; the `metrics` object is the canonical home.

tokens_input_cached_read.description: FAIR-03 substrate (D-12): input tokens served from a prompt cache read, billed at the cached-read rate. Tracked as a separate column so fairness accounting can distinguish cache hits from fresh input.

tokens_input_cache_write.description: FAIR-03 substrate (D-12): input tokens written into the prompt cache, billed at the cache-write rate. Separate column per D-12.

fairness.description: FAIR-03 substrate: fairness accounting attached to this result. Substrate only — the variance detector + cost_quality.md warning are Phase 82/89.

overrides.description: FAIR-03 substrate (D-10): per-mode deviations from the pinned fairness contract, each carrying a free-text waiver_reason and a maintainer approved_by. An empty waiver_reason is rejected at load time by the runtime fairness loader (Phase 80+), not by this schema.

mode.description: The profile mode this override applies to.

waiver_reason.description: Free-text justification for deviating from the fairness contract (D-10).

metrics.description: METRIC-01/D-06 canonical metric record. Every metric is nullable; a missing metric is an explicit JSON null (D-07), never an omission. Carries the 17 METRIC-01/02 metrics plus the 2 FAIR-03 cached-token columns (D-03). Mirrors the Go evaluators.Metrics struct json tags 1:1 (snake_case key parity is the contract every Wave-2 grader and Wave-3 wiring consumes).

task_success.description: Whether the task's success oracle passed (METRIC-01).

verified_correctness.description: Whether the stronger verified-correctness oracle passed (METRIC-01).

tokens_input.description: Total input (prompt) tokens billed for this run.

tokens_output.description: Total output (completion) tokens billed for this run.

tokens_input_cached_read.description: FAIR-03 substrate (D-03): input tokens served from a prompt cache read.

tokens_input_cache_write.description: FAIR-03 substrate (D-03): input tokens written into the prompt cache.

tool_calls.description: Total number of tool calls made during the run.

wall_time_seconds.description: Wall-clock duration of the run in seconds.

files_read.description: Number of files read during the run.

bytes_read.description: Total bytes read during the run.

files_modified.description: Number of files modified during the run.

edit_locality.description: Fraction of edits concentrated in the intended region (0..1).

lsp_diagnostics_used.description: Number of LSP diagnostics consulted during the run.

semantic_tool_calls.description: Number of semantic (SMTC) tool calls made during the run.

edit_distance_patch.description: Edit distance between the produced patch and the reference patch.

retry_count.description: Number of retries during the run.

compile_errors_before.description: Compile error count before the agent's edits.

compile_errors_after.description: Compile error count after the agent's edits.

ablation_status.description: OPTIONAL D-03 machine-checkable ablation deferral marker. Additive-only (no schema major bump; schema_version stays "v2"). Honest modes OMIT this key entirely (the Go builder uses omitempty); it is present only on a partial ablation arm. Greppable enum values: "guarantee_pending_phase_81" marks the no_semantic arm whose kernel disable_semantic_subsystem guarantee is deferred to Phase 81 (SET by the cell wiring in Plan 03); honest modes omit it (and may set "enforced" once Phase 81 lands). The Phase 82 aggregator reads it to distinguish a partial no_semantic row from a clean measurement.

language.description: OPTIONAL Phase 85 (ADAPTER-AIDER-01) language-axis provenance key. Additive-only (no schema major bump; schema_version stays "v2"; additionalProperties left OPEN; NOT added to required). Honest provenance populated from the cell's Cell.Language; a row written before the language axis existed (or a non-per-language path) OMITS this key entirely (the Go builder uses omitempty), so pre-language artifacts stay byte-compatible and still validate. The aggregator reads it to slice per-language pass-rate (SC#1's "Python pass-rate").

metric_errors.description: D-07 per-metric grader-failure annotations. When a grader cannot compute a metric it leaves the metrics field null and records why here. Mirrors the Go evaluators.MetricError struct.

metric.description: Name of the metric the grader failed to compute (matches a metrics property key).

grader.description: Identifier of the grader that failed.

reason.description: Free-text explanation of why the metric could not be computed.
